project.name: ml-ids-zero-trust-cloud
project.description: A Python machine learning intrusion detection project for cloud network security using a Zero Trust architecture. This capstone fork integrates an AWS data, training, deployment, and monitoring workflow.

tour.title: Project and Zero Trust Context
tour.description: Start with the project overview, then read the Zero Trust framework that motivates its intrusion detection design. The README distinguishes inherited research results from measurements made in this AWS fork; that distinction matters when interpreting later evaluation and deployment evidence.

tour.title: Prediction API Entry Point
tour.description: The FastAPI service is a direct runtime entry point for single and batch network flow predictions. It exposes health and model discovery routes while loading trained detectors on demand; follow its dependency on the shared model wrappers to see what a prediction calls.

tour.title: Research Data and Exploration
tour.description: The dataset guide explains where NSL-KDD and CICIDS-2018 inputs come from and which processed artifacts the project expects. The exploration notebook then shows the class balance, attack categories, and feature distributions that shape preprocessing and model choice.

tour.title: Preprocessing and Curated Data
tour.description: Local preprocessing encodes labels and features, selects inputs, and saves training artifacts, while the SageMaker path creates leakage safe train, validation, and official test splits. The Glue jobs convert the two benchmark datasets into curated Parquet, linking raw S3 ingestion to AWS analytics and training.

tour.title: Model Experiments and Metrics
tour.description: The shared model wrappers cover classical learners, LSTM, and autoencoder variants; MLflow training records comparable runs and artifacts. Evaluation produces classification and operational metrics, so inspect these files together before treating any single accuracy figure as the full outcome.

tour.title: SageMaker Training Jobs
tour.description: The SageMaker classical training entry point consumes prepared NumPy splits and packages a model with its preprocessor and validation metrics. Its evaluation counterpart scores untouched KDDTest+ data, while the LSTM job preserves ordered flow windows and packages TensorFlow Serving artifacts.

tour.title: Training and Registration Gates
tour.description: The classical SageMaker pipeline joins preprocessing, training, official test evaluation, an F1 gate, and pending model registration. The LSTM pipeline provides a separate path for windowed sequence data; these definitions show where training outputs become candidate releases.

tour.title: Serving Models on SageMaker
tour.description: The SageMaker inference hooks load packaged model and preprocessor artifacts, validate JSON features, transform inputs, and serialize predictions. The endpoint deployment and smoke scripts show how an approved package is exposed and checked against a real NSL-KDD test row after registration.

tour.title: Cloud Foundation and Data Stack
tour.description: The foundation CloudFormation template defines encrypted data and artifact buckets plus service roles; the data template adds Glue catalog resources, ETL jobs, Athena, and optional Firehose delivery. The matching deployment scripts reveal the ordering and identity checks needed before data preparation or SageMaker jobs can run.

tour.title: Identity and Automated Workflows
tour.description: The GitHub OIDC template creates a scoped path from Actions into AWS, and the CI workflow checks Python syntax and CloudFormation. The manual AWS smoke and training workflows use that identity to inspect or start named SageMaker pipelines, connecting repository changes to controlled cloud operations.

tour.title: Drift Signals and Dashboard
tour.description: The drift monitor calculates feature PSI, prediction shifts, and optional performance degradation, while the AWS demo compares stable, shifted, and official test windows. Publishing moves summary metrics to CloudWatch, whose alarm template defines a threshold; the Streamlit dashboard lets an operator inspect the detailed reports.

tour.title: Deployment Evidence and Operations
tour.description: The AWS deployment status and report separate verified resources and measured outcomes from proposed architecture. Use the operations runbook to trace daily checks, release and rollback, drift response, and shutdown after understanding the components that generate the evidence.
